name: Trips - Right - 18 Sweep

QB.rule: Take the snap and sweep right, flat and fast, behind the split end. Turn up outside his block.

TB.rule: Run hard to the left like you have the ball. Sell it all the way — you are the reason the defense goes the wrong way.

coaching_points: The quarterback keeps it every time — tell him before the snap, there is no read.
The tailback's fake is the play. The split end takes the force man; the slot screens the corner.
